questions.question: Which ancient Indian dynasty is credited with the construction of the Sanchi Stupa?
questions.explanation: The Mauryan dynasty, specifically Emperor Ashoka, is credited with the construction of the Sanchi Stupa.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Bahmani Kingdom in the Deccan region?
questions.explanation: Alauddin Bahman Shah founded the Bahmani Kingdom in 1347.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: What was the main demand of the Non-Cooperation Movement launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1920?
questions.explanation: The main demand of the Non-Cooperation Movement was Swaraj, or self-rule.

questions.question: Which of the following ancient Indian texts is a treatise on statecraft and politics?
questions.explanation: The Arthashastra, written by Kautilya, is a treatise on statecraft and politics.

questions.question: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by which of the following brothers?
questions.explanation: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by Harihara and Bukka Raya in 1336.

questions.question: The British East India Company was granted a royal charter by which English monarch?
questions.explanation: The British East India Company was granted a royal charter by King James I in 1600.

questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942.

questions.question: The ancient Indian university of Taxila was located in which modern-day country?
questions.explanation: The ancient Indian university of Taxila was located in modern-day Pakistan.

questions.question: The Mughal emperor Akbar introduced which of the following administrative reforms?
questions.explanation: Akbar introduced the Mansabdari system, Jagirdari system, and Pargana system as administrative reforms.

questions.question: What is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area, covering approximately 342,239 square kilometers.

questions.question: Which mountain range runs along the eastern edge of India?
questions.explanation: The Purvachal mountain range runs along the eastern edge of India, stretching from Arunachal Pradesh to Myanmar.

questions.question: What is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: The Ganges is the longest river in India, stretching approximately 2,525 kilometers from its source to the Bay of Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following climates is characterized by high temperatures and high humidity?
questions.explanation: Tropical wet climate is characterized by high temperatures and high humidity, typically found in regions near the equator.

questions.question: What is the largest delta in India?
questions.explanation: The Ganges Delta is the largest delta in India, covering an area of approximately 59,000 square kilometers.

questions.question: Which state is the largest producer of iron ore in India?
questions.explanation: Odisha is the largest producer of iron ore in India, accounting for over 50% of the country's total iron ore production.

questions.question: What is the name of the strait that separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India from Sri Lanka, connecting the Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar.

questions.question: Which of the following types of soil is found in the river deltas of India?
questions.explanation: Alluvial soil is found in the river deltas of India, formed by the deposition of sediments carried by rivers.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest peak in the Western Ghats mountain range?
questions.explanation: Anamudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats mountain range, located in the state of Kerala.

questions.question: Which state is the largest producer of coal in India?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand is the largest producer of coal in India, accounting for over 25% of the country's total coal production.

questions.question: What is the term of office for the Chairman of the Finance Commission of India?
questions.explanation: The Chairman of the Finance Commission of India holds office for a term of 5 years.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental right under the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: The Right to Property was removed as a fundamental right by the 44th Amendment to the Constitution of India in 1978.

questions.question: Who is the head of the Panchayati Raj system at the village level?
questions.explanation: The head of the Panchayati Raj system at the village level is known by different names in different states, such as Sarpanch, Gram Pradhan, or Mukhiya.

questions.question: What is the minimum number of members required for a Parliamentary Committee?
questions.explanation: The minimum number of members required for a Parliamentary Committee is 5.

questions.question: Who has the power to grant pardon, reprieve, or respite in cases involving punishment or sentence by a court-martial?
questions.explanation: The President has the power to grant pardon, reprieve, or respite in cases involving punishment or sentence by a court-martial.

questions.question: Which article of the Constitution of India deals with the protection of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes from social injustices and all forms of exploitation?
questions.explanation: Article 46 of the Constitution of India deals with the protection of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes from social injustices and all forms of exploitation.

questions.question: How many members are elected to the Lok Sabha from the Union Territory of Delhi?
questions.explanation: Seven members are elected to the Lok Sabha from the Union Territory of Delhi.

questions.question: What is the minimum age for a person to be eligible to contest elections to the Lok Sabha?
questions.explanation: The minimum age for a person to be eligible to contest elections to the Lok Sabha is 25 years.

questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Indian Federal System?
questions.explanation: Single citizenship is a feature of the Indian Federal System.
